en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4024 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from a man who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (as): "May Allah (swt) rectify your affairs. We interact with some people from the countryside, and we lend them loans. They deliver their crops to us, and we sell them for a fee, and we benefit from this arrangement."
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
And I believe he also said: "If it were not for the crops they deliver to us, we would not lend to them."
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
